Get well soon

I wish I could be right there beside you, holding your hand until this fever is gone.

I’m not there, but I’m with you

Even from far away, my heart is sitting right next to you, just like this little bear. I’m thinking about you every minute.

Please take care of yourself

  • Rest as much as you can
  • Drink plenty of warm water
  • Eat something light, even a little
  • Take your medicine the way the doctor says

And if the fever is very high or does not go down in a day or two, please see a doctor. Your health matters most to me.

A warm cup, just for you

Imagine I made it for you and brought it to your bed. Sip it slowly, and feel my hug around you.

Your get-well meter

Tap the button each time you feel a little bit better.

Open when…

You are stronger than you think, and I believe in you. Rest now, and tomorrow will be softer.

Close your eyes and imagine my hand in yours. Breathe slowly. I am right here, even in the quiet.

I miss you more than words can say. Soon I will hold you tight, and I will not let go for a long time.

Rest, my love

Get well soon. The world feels quiet and empty until you are smiling again.

Yours, always ♥
